card.name: Words just before "first use"
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected "first" or "initial", such as "before", "on" and "using". Mostly in priming instructions ("prime before first use"), and also in "spell out on first reference".

modes.label: Priming before first use
modes.description: Prime, before or using, leading into "first use" or "initial use" in inhaler or nasal spray directions.
modes.example: Prime ALVESCO<< before>> first use or when inhaler not used

modes.label: Spell out on first reference
modes.description: The word "on" in style-guide advice to spell out an acronym on first reference.

card.writes: It promotes the word "first" and its equivalents in Chinese and Japanese, so the model expects "first" next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before "first use" or "first time" in instructions.
